title: Dolphin controllable swing + reliable reset
hypothesis: Different parameterized input traces produce recognized, distinguishable Wii Sports golf swings
success_criteria: At least 3 recognized swing variations, 30 logged outcomes and repeatability audit
blocked_by: Dolphin installation and legally sourced game

title: Verify golf score extraction and units
hypothesis: Game output can be measured with >=95% agreement against manual annotations
success_criteria: Validated raw measurement, unit conversion and hole-out flag

title: Controller response surface
hypothesis: Low-dimensional input features predict distance outcomes
success_criteria: Action-response plot and held-out prediction error

title: Elite search vs random under equal budget
hypothesis: Per-configuration search reduces fresh-evaluation distance for seen configurations
success_criteria: Predeclared splits, baselines, confidence intervals and costs

title: Contextual model-based optimizer
hypothesis: A shot-conditioned learned model generalizes to withheld shot configurations
success_criteria: Frozen-model unseen-configuration comparison at equal budgets

title: Falsify observation-publication safety
hypothesis: A known-safe result is accepted and all unreviewed/private fields are rejected before Git runs
null_hypothesis: The shared publisher can still serialize unsupported fields or unsafe identifiers
measurement: Typed schema acceptance, rejection before Git calls, zero private-field leakage
controls: synthetic malicious ID and nested private-field canaries
falsification: Any canary reaches Git writer or a valid historical test is rejected
stop_rule: Hold all new memory publication until S000/S002 agree on schema and targeted+full suites pass
blocked_by: PR #126 Windows validation and S002 #116 schema approval
independence_unit: distinct synthetic records, NOT live shots
success_criteria: Every canary rejected; real published test status preserved; no Git call for invalid input
evidence_now: Observed safe test record 20261025T024510Z-fe87c132b7 plus phase/cohort public record shapes; generic publisher PR #126 validation pending

title: Score-display contamination negative test
hypothesis: Off-green 100-ft penalty and on-green proximity are excluded from physical carry and power labels
null_hypothesis: The current analyzer still treats UI score as measured distance or power
measurement: Count false physical-distance and power targets in sanitized human-labelled observations
falsification: Any penalty/proximity number enters power or carry training feature/target
stop_rule: No controller response-surface fit until zero target contamination is demonstrated
blocked_by: S003 PR #119/#118 review; never use private captures as public evidence
independence_unit: distinct shot/run IDs, not repeated frames
success_criteria: Zero false distance/power targets and explicit unknown/penalty counts
evidence_now: Human off-green 100-ft penalties with repeated ~75% visual meter

title: Cross-capture scene and minimap drift null audit
hypothesis: Recurring candidate changes can be separated from scene/UI/clock drift using phase and source labels
null_hypothesis: The top repeated offsets are generic rendering or scene transitions, not golfer physics
measurement: Per-offset recurrence across independent captures, proportion in known rendering or mode/score regions
falsification: No source-grounded non-rendering candidate remains after negative controls
stop_rule: If all recurrent changes are rendering/UI, do NOT nominate power addresses; move to scene/golfer pointer discovery
blocked_by: S002 PRs #109/#120/#116 reconciliation; source-gated files remain PRIVATE
success_criteria: One role-tagged null-adjusted shortlist or explicit no-identifiable-signal result
evidence_now: Published cohort cohort-20261025T025308Z-fbda2d0e: 24 runs, 84 distinct changing words, 16 universal changes all minimap effects; no verified gameplay fields

title: Source-verified golf scene pointer-chain audit
hypothesis: A source-derived path exists from current scene manager to RPGolScene and mGolMain without guessed instance addresses
null_hypothesis: Static symbols and member +0x9C do not identify a live scene singleton
measurement: Source file and revision references for each pointer link, actual unresolved links enumerated
controls: distinguish function symbols from static data
negative: createInstance/getCurrentScene is NOT instance address
falsification: Any guessed address is required for proposed dereference
stop_rule: Do not probe guessed runtime pointers; label pointer discovery blocked until source chain is justified
independence_unit: independent source facts with correct program revision
success_criteria: Signed-off chain hypothesis listing both supported and unresolved links
evidence_now: RPGolScene member +0x9C known; scene object base unverified

title: Read-only scene identity and pointer stability
hypothesis: The same source-validated live golfer object can be found across two fresh ready-tee boots
null_hypothesis: Candidate is actually scene/field/UI state or relocates without safe identity
measurement: Mode/revision/scene IDs, same-instance pointer validation, per-session stability and transition rejection
falsification: No safe instance identity or incorrect-scene acceptance
stop_rule: Abort on wrong mode/revision, uncertain dereference, pointer relocation or scene mismatch
blocked_by: VAL-SOURCE-04 and S001/S002 approved read-only single-session attach
success_criteria: Stable gameplay-object ownership in 2 independent boots, zero invalid dereferences

title: RPC read-span timing characterization
hypothesis: A source-gated small watchlist is fast enough to see sub-swing frame events without altering input timing
null_hypothesis: Non-atomic reads span or skip too many frames for swing attribution
measurement: p50/p95/max frame_start..frame_end span, skipped frames, counter resets, watchlist size
falsification: p95 read span >2 emulated frames for a planned per-frame claim; or any negative/rollback frame bracket
stop_rule: If p95>2 frames, forbid per-frame swing claims; narrow watchlist or use internal frame hooks and revalidate
blocked_by: S002 #116 timing probes and S001 active bridge frame provenance
success_criteria: Measured span distribution with explicit acceptable temporal-resolution scope; no fabricated event times
evidence_now: Published broad-memory audit max span 22 frames; focused idle/aim/idle control max/mean 9 frames (28 samples, zero changed words); not matched conditions

title: Stillness/camera/A-held negative controls
hypothesis: A genuine stroke-specific candidate is quiet under still, camera-only and A-held-no-motion conditions
null_hypothesis: Candidate responds equally to camera, HUD, A hold or idle drift
measurement: Phase-specific candidate change rate, null-to-motion ratio and stable source identity
falsification: Candidate responds comparably during any no-shot control or is only minimap-rendering state
stop_rule: Do not proceed to a shot-specific causal claim until each no-shot control is recorded and timing valid
blocked_by: VAL-SCENE-05, VAL-LATENCY-06, S001-approved controller A-hold only
independence_unit: independent fresh boots/phase sessions, not snapshots
success_criteria: At least one candidate with documented no-shot specificity or explicit null result
evidence_now: Current phase collector has operator-cued rather than exact swing-event frames

title: Reciprocal frame-anchored same-shot join
hypothesis: Memory and input events from one approved stroke can be joined using shared ID, scene/bridge/trace and observed frame brackets
null_hypothesis: Waveform commands, timestamps and separate phase captures cannot be aligned to one physical stroke
measurement: Reciprocal shot_id, scene and boot IDs, trace/bridge SHA, observed start/completion frame and RAM overlap
controls: wrong-shot and shifted-frame synthetic joins must fail
falsification: Join succeeds on mismatched shot IDs/frames or lacks observed completion frame
stop_rule: No fitting until both real shots meet all join gates; ACK != game-applied input
blocked_by: S001 #112 observed controller clock, S002 same-shot narrow watchlist; S003 #123/#125 canonicalized
success_criteria: 2/2 same-shot joins valid, invalid synthetic joins rejected, power still unverified
evidence_now: No confirmed same-shot RAM/controller frame linkage

title: Observer interference paired baseline
hypothesis: Instrumented RAM sampling preserves recognized stroke outcomes relative to the uninstrumented canonical control
null_hypothesis: Extra RPC sampling changes swing timing, hit rate or power display
measurement: Per-pair contact, human-visible power and controller frame timing (descriptive pilot)
controls: two instrumented shots; fixed original 45-A-lead V1 trace
falsification: Any reproducible controller timing disruption or change from contact to no-contact
stop_rule: Stop instrumenting immediately on timing interference; 2 pairs only feasibility, not statistical equivalence
blocked_by: VAL-JOIN-08; canonical S001 one-shot startup unchanged
independence_unit: four independent boots, paired by protocol not temporal proximity
success_criteria: No observed RPC timing discontinuity; explicitly report low pilot power and uncertainty

title: Observed power gradient and held-out specificity pilot
hypothesis: One S001-approved one-axis variant yields >=3 distinct reproducible human-visible meter levels tied to a golfer-owned memory candidate
null_hypothesis: Multipliers all yield ~75% or RAM candidate tracks only UI/scene, making power unidentifiable
measurement: Distinct display-percent levels >=10 percentage points apart, same-shot candidate response, independent boots; no carry targets
controls: one low and one high one-axis variant each twice
falsification: No >=3 separate displayed levels; response reverses or disappears in independent boots; candidate changes under no-shot controls
stop_rule: Maximum six separately approved shots; if powers cluster ~75% STOP tuning and inspect bridge semantics; do not claim training readiness
blocked_by: VAL-PERTURB-09; explicit S001 parameter approval, S002 independently observed meter and gameplay-owned memory
independence_unit: six independently approved fresh-start shots; holdout never re-used for candidate search
success_criteria: >=3 visually distinct levels, >=2 independent boots per condition, held-out effect not contradicted; still no verified internal power
evidence_now: Existing speed/backswing variation produced nearly identical human power estimates
